intro: Prestique builds custom AI voice and text agents for small businesses. When your salon or spa runs Zenoti, the agent connects to Zenoti's API rather than working from a separate source. Zenoti provides an API to retrieve available slots for a service booking, so the agent can check that information when a caller asks. You keep Zenoti; the agent works alongside it.

You control what the agent says and does. It only does what Zenoti's API allows and what you have approved it to do. Anything outside that goes to your team with a summary of the call. Every call is recorded with a transcript and a summary of what the caller needed.
